problem_text:
A shipping company must select packages to load onto a cargo plane. Available packages are:
* Package 1: weight 47kg, revenue $218
* Package 2: weight 47kg, revenue $28
* Package 3: weight 2kg, revenue $222
* Package 4: weight 36kg, revenue $53
* Package 5: weight 18kg, revenue $23
* Package 6: weight 2kg, revenue $262
* Package 7: weight 44kg, revenue $209
* Package 8: weight 35kg, revenue $189
* Package 9: weight 36kg, revenue $251
* Package 10: weight 34kg, revenue $237
* Package 11: weight 36kg, revenue $253
* Package 12: weight 38kg, revenue $104
* Package 13: weight 38kg, revenue $22
* Package 14: weight 39kg, revenue $192
* Package 15: weight 14kg, revenue $167
* Package 16: weight 28kg, revenue $44
* Package 17: weight 15kg, revenue $59
* Package 18: weight 11kg, revenue $242
* Package 19: weight 41kg, revenue $75
* Package 20: weight 32kg, revenue $171

The aircraft has a maximum cargo capacity of 415 kg. Choose the set of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
